name: opudas-paint

scripts.build: node ../tools/build-sitemap.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings ../tools/export-content-snapshot.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && npm run prerender

description: OPUDA'S PAINT — colour, product and project platform
